title: Rocky Horror Picture Show Yoga with Lianna
description: Let's do the time warp... on our yoga mat! 45 minute flow led by Lianna Lee. Stick around for a free outdoor screening of RHPS right after.

About this Event

🖤 LET’S DO THE TIME WARP… on a yoga mat. 🖤
Join us Thursday, October 15 at 6:15 PM for a Rocky Horror Picture Show–inspired yoga class that’s equal parts spooky, silly, and stretchy. 👠✨
Then stick around after class for an outdoor screening of The Rocky Horror Picture Show under the stars. 🌙🎬
Come for the yoga. Stay for the cult classic. Maybe bring your fishnets. 💋
